bull.b: LOQTORZI is showing measurable commercial traction, with sequential sales growth, improving patient starts and better treatment duration. If management sustains the guided 10%–15% quarterly growth range, the product can become a more meaningful recurring revenue base.

Sustained reductions in R&D and SG&A indicate a leaner operating structure after the divestiture. Continued expense discipline can extend available funding, reduce the scale of future cash needs and improve the earnings impact of commercial growth.

The interim TREGCHECK results provide early clinical support for tagmokitug and the company’s CCR8-focused immuno-oncology strategy across multiple tumor types. Further validation could broaden the pipeline’s strategic value and create additional product opportunities.

bear.b: Large recurring operating and free-cash-flow losses mean the business is not currently self-funding. Even with cost reductions and stated funding through key readouts, continued burn increases dependence on financing, asset proceeds or faster commercial improvement.

The sharp revenue contraction and swing from prior profit to substantial losses show limited earnings durability. Deeply negative margins leave little operating leverage today and make future performance highly dependent on successful product scaling and disciplined spending.

The oncology strategy depends on converting preliminary efficacy and biomarker signals into mature, reproducible data and eventual regulatory progress. Until that evidence develops, pipeline value remains exposed to changing results, slower development and approval uncertainty.
